supersedes.reason: Corrected bootstrap implementation: moving blocks of 3 consecutive trades; v1.0 OOS bootstrap produced empty samples.

specification.hypothesis: A pullback to EMA20 within an altcoin 4h trend, confirmed by BTC trend, may yield positive net expectancy.
specification.trend: EMA20/EMA50 alignment plus EMA50 slope over 5 bars.
specification.volatility: ATR14/close quartiles fitted on training only; shock filter is training 99th percentile absolute one-bar return.
specification.signal: Long low <= EMA20+0.25*ATR14, close>EMA20, close>open; short symmetric.
specification.btcConfirmation: BTC trend direction equals altcoin direction.
specification.entry: Next 4h open after completed signal candle.
specification.exits: 1.5 ATR stop, 2R target, 12-bar time stop; stop-first if both levels hit.
specification.sizing: 0.5% equity risk, 3x notional cap, one position per symbol.
specification.costs: 5bp taker fee per side; 2bp slippage plus 0.5bp half-spread per side.
specification.funding: Historical fundingRate cashflow at fundingTime; positive rate charged to longs and credited to shorts.
specification.robustness: 0.15/0.35 ATR tolerance sensitivity; 3-symbol Holm correction; 3-day moving-block bootstrap, 1,200 iterations.

data.source: Connected Binance USDⓈ-M integration; endpoint mappings /fapi/v1/klines and /fapi/v1/fundingRate; HTTP statuses not exposed.

limitations: This is an independent pure JS research harness, not the repository TypeScript ReplayService.
Only one untouched 50-day OOS window; no multi-window walk-forward.
Trade counts are far below the 100 per symbol/context provisional gate.
Bootstrap uses moving blocks of 3 consecutive trades; small samples produce wide uncertainty.
Max drawdown is realized trade-to-trade; max intratrade MAE is reported separately.
Historical spread unavailable; fixed spread/slippage assumptions used.
No SHA-256 primitive exposed; GitHub blob SHA-1 retained.
